newsitem.title: SPAIN: Electric protocol seen next wk - Spain Industry Min.
newsitem.headline: Electric protocol seen next wk - Spain Industry Min.

text.p: Spain's electricity protocol, which will lay down guidelines for a new set of sector regulations, will not be signed this week but is likely to go ahead next week, an Industry Ministry spokesman told Reuters on Wednesday.

"It won't be signed this week, but there's a likelihood it will be signed next week," the spokesman said, declining to comment further on ongoing negotations between the governement and electricity firms.

Initially, Industry Minister Josep Pique said the protocol was due to be signed before the end of November. However, the difficulty of reaching an agreement on a more competitive framework has delayed it.
